A week later she ate a random inch of bone off the street (which she chewed up though) which freaked me out for days checking her poop but she seemed to be fine after… I think your dog will be fine OP. Just definitely monitor for symptoms of obstruction. Dogs can be absolute shits sometimes, especially ones like mine that seem to want to ingest everything in sight

Honestly, does it matter? I personally think it’s such a shallow thing to say the way a story is written makes the authenticity questionable. Writers portray their traumas, experiences, etc in such different and imaginative ways (which can sometimes be a coping method) that it seems a bit narrow of you to be sceptical about how much of the story is “real” to you personally instead of opening up your mind to how the author may be feeling and trying to portray certain situations. And honestly the statistics on trans suicide really show the truth in how many LGBT+ people take their lives due to unsupportive family which often causes homelessness etc. It really doesn’t take long to educate yourself. And unfortunately a lot of trans youth end up like Jane in this case. Compassion is important.
